source.title: Gemdust is still miserable — Diffracted's 200 Brilliant Silver
source.author: Diffracted-3169329

quote: 200 silver prospected 43 times: 0 diamonds. 34 gems prospected into 24 gem dust.
specialization: Has points in the prospecting tree; whether the diamond node is learned is not stated
notes: Recorded by Claude (live session with ChatGPT). Posted 2026-05-05, after the 2026-03-31 Midnight gem change; collection date not stated. 43 completed prospects from 200 ore (fewer than 200/5 because of Resourcefulness or leftover ore; author's own cast count). 34 = gems in aggregate, types and quality not given, so outputItemID is null; reading '34 gems prospected into 24 gem dust' as 34 gems obtained, later crushed into 24 gem dust (crushing, not prospecting). Ore rank not stated. Weak evidence: aggregate only.
